tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description:
[AIFinder - 한국어 되는 AI 찾기] Find alternatives to an AI service within the same category, ranked by a public rule-based score (not ads or user ratings). Up to 5 results.

tools.name: compare_category

[AIFinder - 한국어 되는 AI 찾기] Compare the top AI services in one secondary category on Korean UI, KRW pricing, starting price and trial conditions. Up to 10 services.
